name: $AVGO Observer

tweets.text: Fair point. Hard to 'avoid' the companies funding the whole stack and then buy what's downstream of them. For AVGO it comes down to Dec 9: earnings land the same day as the Fed, and the guide will show whether custom silicon demand is still holding up.

The $179B backlog is the part that matters. Friday's move to $312.34 still leaves AVGO below its $325.36 20-day average, and with earnings on Dec 9, the real test is how much of that backlog converts into AI revenue on schedule.
Tepper 的 Appaloosa 三季度清仓了全部 15 万股 AVGO，加仓 NVDA 约 31%、Micron 约 28%。另一边，博通约 10 亿美元认购的 Anthropic 上市首周浮盈约 10.7%。大户也在分歧，裁决得等 12/9 财报。 $AVGO
Worth watching, though 2029 specs can still evolve as you note. The nearer test for Broadcom's custom silicon story is Dec 9 earnings, with Q4 consensus around $3.83 EPS on ~$34.9B revenue.
財報前 IV Rank 94、IVP 99.2%，波動率確實到了罕見的高位。關鍵不在高本身，而是 12/9 財報後 IV crush 之後能不能守住相對高的基準，這才是判斷多空的關鍵。$AVGO
11月5日 AVGO 跌超10%、逼近52周低点那天，木头姐的 ARKK 反手清了约99%的持仓，约1.04亿美元。Barchart 说这笔卖出可能在12月9日财报前付出代价。 $AVGO

The capex number is the part that matters for AVGO: $1.07T toward semis and servers, plus $158.5B for network gear. But the market is only pricing 2% EPS growth, so the gap between spending plans and delivered earnings is the risk. Dec 9 will be a useful check.

BNEF's numbers are striking: data-center power demand quadruples to 2,354 TWh by 2035, about 7% of global electricity. Power is becoming as much of a bottleneck as chips, and Broadcom's custom silicon and networking sit right in the middle of that buildout. $AVGO
This is the AVGO angle that matters here. If most of Anthropic's token generation runs on Google-Broadcom TPUs, the Dec 9 earnings call should say a lot about whether the order-cut talk has any legs.
今天感恩节休市，补个基本面：Zacks 昨天盘了下博通的资产负债表，债务从 67.1B 降到 61.1B，现金升到 24B，Q3 自由现金流 137 亿、占收入 46%，2027 财年没有到期本金。表外约 29B 的 AI 租赁担保还在，空方不会放过这点。 $AVGO
